external_read.approval: user scope or applicable research policy

live_or_privileged.approval: specific human authorization and valid action envelope

destructive_or_irreversible.approval: fresh explicit confirmation after exact target readback

coverage_limits: PreToolUse can guard supported local tool calls but is not a complete security boundary.
Hosted tools may not traverse the same local hook path.
PostToolUse observes an already completed action and cannot undo side effects.
Unregistered MCP tools are denied by the local policy guard; other unknown hosted integrations remain disabled or prompt-gated by Codex until inventoried.
